name: Arrival and Legitimacy
main_objective: Survival, language acquisition, establishing social trust, and seeding the first reproducible workshop-school.
major_constraints: Physical vulnerability and zero modern tools
Language and cultural barriers
Risk of political or religious persecution
exit_conditions: Protected workshop-school under local community trust
Stable food and shelter security
First cohort of apprentices capable of replicating basic techniques
Durable duplicate documentation established
priority_workstreams: Linguistic and ethnographic immersion
Modest, verifiable technical demonstrations (surveying, measurement, hygiene)
Multi-institutional relationship building
Apprentice selection and training

name: Food, Health, Measurement, and Records
main_objective: Systematize food surplus, public health, metrology, and administrative literacy to sustain specialized craftsmen.
major_constraints: Flood variability and drought vulnerabilities
High infant and maternal mortality
Post-harvest storage pests and spoilage
exit_conditions: Multi-year grain storage reserves with under 5% annual spoilage
Standardized system of weights, measures, and land surveying
Basic public health practices (potable water, waste separation) widely adopted
Scribal schools generating self-replicating technical records
priority_workstreams: Basin irrigation, canal maintenance, and nilometer tracking
Selective crop breeding and legume crop rotations
Ceramic sealed granaries with pest-resistant aeration
Calibration standards for mass, length, volume, and time

name: Materials, Trade, Law, and Infrastructure
main_objective: Establish regional trade corridors, extractive metallurgy, civil engineering, and durable legal institutions.
major_constraints: Tin scarcity for bronze metallurgy
High overland transport energy costs
Political instability across dynastic successions
exit_conditions: Redundant regional supply chains for copper, tin, and timber
Standardized contract law, weight standards, and dispute resolution courts
Permanent road and canal networks with engineered maintenance schedules
Autonomous technical guilds independent of single royal dynasties
priority_workstreams: Copper smelting optimization, tuyeres, and crucible development
Long-distance maritime and pack-caravan logistics networks
Surveying instruments, paved causeways, and canal locks
Contractual property rights and worker compensation codes

name: Mechanical Power, Iron, Optics, and Reproducible Knowledge
main_objective: Harness non-muscular mechanical energy (water/wind), bloomery and cast iron, precision optics, and movable-type printing.
major_constraints: Refractory furnace materials for iron smelting temperatures (>1200 C)
Charcoal and timber depletion limits
Glass purity and grinding tolerances for scientific optics
exit_conditions: Waterwheels and windmills performing staple milling and forge work
Systematic bloomery iron and quench-tempered steel tool production
Movable type printing presses disseminating standardized technical manuals
Microscopes and astronomical instruments enabling empirical natural science
priority_workstreams: Bellows-driven bloomery and blast furnaces with lime fluxes
Undershot, overshot, and breastshot waterwheel mechanical drive trains
Optical glass annealing, lens grinding, and compound microscope construction
Rags-to-paper pulping mills and movable metal alloy type casting

name: Industrial Chemistry, Steam, and Precision Manufacturing
main_objective: Create self-reproducing machine tools, thermal steam engines, mineral coal-coke metallurgy, and heavy chemical synthesis.
major_constraints: Cylinder boring precision tolerances (preventing steam blow-by)
Boiler explosion hazards under elevated steam pressures
Corrosion from concentrated industrial acids and alkalis
exit_conditions: Wilkinson-style boring mills and slide-rest screw-cutting lathes
High-pressure condensing steam engines powering factories and locomotives
Continuous chamber sulfuric acid and Solvay soda ash manufacturing
Bessemer and open-hearth mass steel production
priority_workstreams: Precision lead screw generation and optical flat surface plates
Atmospheric Newcomen progressing to Watt condensing steam engines
Lead-chamber sulfuric acid and alkali industrial production
Coke-fueled blast furnaces and puddling/Bessemer steelmaking

name: Electricity, Communications, Modern Industry, and Computing
main_objective: Harness electromagnetism for energy distribution and telecommunications, synthesize ammonia, and construct early digital computing.
major_constraints: High-conductivity copper wire drawing and dielectric insulation
Extreme high-pressure/temperature catalytic vessels for Haber-Bosch
Vacuum tube and electromechanical relay reliability limits
exit_conditions: Regional high-voltage alternating current (AC) electrical transmission grids
Global undersea telegraphy and transoceanic radio communication networks
Synthetic Haber-Bosch ammonia fertilizer feeding expanded populations
Stored-program electronic digital computers with high-level compilers
priority_workstreams: Electromagnetic dynamos, induction motors, and step-up transformers
Petroleum refining, fractional distillation, and synthetic polymers
Haber-Bosch catalytic ammonia synthesis at 200 atm and 450 C
Thermionic vacuum tubes, binary logic gates, and magnetic core memory

name: Information, Space, Nuclear Energy, and Advanced Frontier
main_objective: Master subatomic physics, microelectronics photolithography, multi-stage orbital spaceflight, and distributed artificial intelligence.
major_constraints: Sub-micron semiconductor purity, cleanrooms, and photolithography masks
Uranium isotope enrichment ($^{235}U$) and radiation containment
Extreme cryogenic fuels and high-temperature supersonic gas dynamics
exit_conditions: Deep sub-micron CMOS microprocessors and global interconnected internet
Controlled nuclear fission reactors producing base-load zero-carbon electricity
Orbital launch vehicles deploying communication and observation satellites
High-energy particle accelerators probing fundamental physics (CERN-scale)
priority_workstreams: Czochralski single-crystal silicon boule pulling and photolithography
Nuclear fuel cycle: uranium enrichment, zirconium cladding, PWR safety loops
Staged combustion cryogenic rocket engines and orbital space stations (ISS)
High-performance compute clusters, deep neural networks, and LLM systems

name: Consolidation and Planetary Resilience
main_objective: Build redundant planetary survival infrastructure, asteroid deflection / planetary defense systems, and decentralized technological autonomy.
major_constraints: Single-point-of-failure vulnerabilities in global infrastructure
Long-term nuclear and ecological waste stewardship
Geopolitical coordination under existential stress
exit_conditions: Fully diversified off-grid redundant manufacturing and agricultural domes
Early warning space telescope arrays and kinetic impactor planetary defense
Permanent off-world self-sustaining scientific habitats
Complete decentralized open-source technological archives replicated globally
priority_workstreams: Deep-space asteroid and comet infrared tracking arrays
Automated robotic manufacturing and closed-loop ECLSS life support
Underground and orbital seed/knowledge seed vaults
Autonomous fault-tolerant robotic repair and resource extraction
